events.body:
## Summary

Add and run a final verification pass for the BLT-Hackathons UI revamp, provider support, GSoC 2027 warmup config, docs, and deployment expectations.

## Scope

- Verify parser and generated JSON compatibility.
- Run local static site checks.
- Manually QA homepage and event detail pages.
- Check mobile and dark mode.
- Check browser console.
- Check GitLab and GitHub provider links.
- Check basic accessibility: keyboard focus, semantic headings, alt text, contrast, reduced broken links.

## Suggested files

- Modify: `TESTING.md`
- Modify: `README.md` or `AGENT.md` if QA workflow changes
- Fix frontend/docs files as issues are found.

## Required commands

```bash
python -m py_compile fetch_stats.py
node scripts/parse_hackathons_config.js public/js/hackathons-config.js /tmp/hackathons-config-parsed.json
python -m json.tool public/stats.json >/dev/null
python -m json.tool public/hackathon-data/gsoc-2026-warmup.json >/dev/null
python -m json.tool public/hackathon-data/gsoc-2026-warmup-summary.json >/dev/null
python -m http.server 8000 --directory public
```

## Manual QA matrix

- [ ] `/`
- [ ] `/hackathon.html?slug=gsoc-2026-warmup`
- [ ] `/hackathon.html?slug=gsoc-2027-warmup`
- [ ] mobile viewport
- [ ] dark mode
- [ ] browser console has no errors
- [ ] GitLab event links point to GitLab projects/issues/MRs
- [ ] GitHub event links still point to GitHub repos/issues/PRs
- [ ] empty sponsors/prizes state
- [ ] missing generated JSON state
- [ ] keyboard tab order
- [ ] visible focus states
- [ ] external links use `rel="noopener noreferrer"`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All required commands pass.
- [ ] Manual QA matrix is completed and documented in the MR.
- [ ] Mobile layout is usable.
- [ ] Dark mode is readable.
- [ ] No console errors on primary pages.
- [ ] Provider links are correct for both GitLab and GitHub events.
- [ ] Any remaining limitations are documented as follow-up issues.

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-hackathons/-/issues/12 (opened by @mdkaifansari04 on 2026-06-07).

**Discussion summary**

- The GitLab-specific checks ("GitLab event links point to GitLab projects") now apply to the `forkmesh` provider that the GSoC 2027 warm-up uses (2bc7daab38).
